bf_turn.label: Exact turn
bf_turn.help: The turn the mod gives this piece back as the world loads.

bf_name.label: Station name
bf_name.help: The name in the trains' station menu. Each station's must be its own.

bf_stop.label: Stop
bf_stop.help: A station sign: where on the track trains stop. A train: how far along its route it stops.

bf_bare.label: Without legs
bf_bare.help: An old station built without its wooden legs (on supports instead).

bf_line.label: Track line
bf_line.help: The line of track this vehicle stands on, by its two ends.

bf_at.label: Along the line
bf_at.help: How far along its line this vehicle stands, in metres.

bf_dir.label: Facing
bf_dir.help: Which way along its line this vehicle faces.

bf_trail.label: Lines behind
bf_trail.help: The lines of track the wagons stand on behind the train.

bf_route.label: Route
bf_route.help: The lines of track a sent train still runs on to its stop.

bf_after.label: Lines past the stop
bf_after.help: The lines past the stop the train's wagons need.

bf_legs.label: Later legs
bf_legs.help: The legs of the trip after the one under way.

bf_moving.label: Sent
bf_moving.help: The train was sent to a station and is on its way.

bf_wagons.label: Wagons
bf_wagons.help: The wagons this train pulls, in order.

bf_self.label: Wagon's own id
bf_self.help: This wagon's id as the mod last saw it: how it finds its wagons again.

bf_coal.label: Coal
bf_coal.help: The fuel in the locomotive: coal, or the item the server's Fuel setting names (Railroads 0.3.6).

bf_dest.label: Sent to
bf_dest.help: The station the train is on its way to.

bf_way.label: Way
bf_way.help: Which way the sent train runs this leg: 1 forward, -1 backward.

bf_deck_key.label: Deck id
bf_deck_key.help: This flatbed's own id, which the pieces built on its deck name.

bf_deck.label: On the deck of
bf_deck.help: The flatbed this piece is built on: the mod carries it with the train.

bf_torch0.label: First lamp's fuel
bf_torch0.help: The fuel left in this vehicle's first lamp.

bf_torch1.label: Second lamp's fuel
bf_torch1.help: The fuel left in this vehicle's second lamp.

bf_torch0_time.label: First lamp counted at
bf_torch0_time.help: When the first lamp's fuel was last counted, in the game's ticks.

bf_torch1_time.label: Second lamp counted at
bf_torch1_time.help: When the second lamp's fuel was last counted, in the game's ticks.

bf_train_name.label: Train name
bf_train_name.help: On the boards on the boiler, the map and the train console. Empty: the train goes by its number. The game takes up to 30 characters.

bf_train_number.label: Train number
bf_train_number.help: The number the server gave this train, which it goes by while it has no name.

bf_train_count.label: Trains numbered
bf_train_count.help: The last number the server gave a train: the next train gets the one after.

bf_leg.label: Support
bf_leg.help: A support pole under track or a station, of: 1 wood, 2 core wood, 3 iron.

bf_leg_part.label: Support part
bf_leg_part.help: 0 a post, 5 a knee (a 45° beam along the rails).

bf_leg_free.label: Free support
bf_leg_free.help: Built for nothing: gives nothing back when removed.

bf_paid_wood.label: Paid wood
bf_paid_wood.help: What removing this track gives back.

bf_paid_stone.label: Paid stone
bf_paid_stone.help: What removing this track gives back.

bf_corewood.label: Paid core wood
bf_corewood.help: What removing this track gives back.

bf_paid_items.label: Paid with
bf_paid_items.help: What this piece was paid with, by the game's item names, which removing it gives back. -: nothing.

bf_bridge_up.label: Raised
bf_bridge_up.help: The drawbridge's leaves are up, for ships: trains stop before it. The mod raises it only with no train on it.

bf_bridge_from.label: Swing from
bf_bridge_from.help: How far up the leaves were when they last began to swing: 0 down, 1 up.

bf_bridge_since.label: Swing began at
bf_bridge_since.help: When the leaves last began to swing, in the game's ticks. A swing takes 8 seconds.

bf_sent_by.label: Sent by
bf_sent_by.help: The player who sent the train, told when a raised drawbridge holds it.
